_about: Built-in browser, in four tabs (sixth refine pass, 2026-11-24; Jared: "There also needs to be a lot more settings for browser, browser work, recordings, etc. Like gpu acceleration, formats, and all that stuff."). Browser: the engine (graphics, window and page, signing in, downloads). Browser work: what the assistant may do in it, its pace, what counts as a problem. Recordings: when, picture, format, storage. Screenshots: the one capture switch (shared with Testing), retention and redaction read from their owners, the picture, comparing, pointing at things. The rows that are new are proposed (../../../../../proposed/browser-rows.json in the refine concept); their ids are placed by 24a-browser-rows.json, which sorts before Testing's rules.
